title: Visitor counting input (v0.5, D36 amendment 2026-10-29)
description: Input of the per-request visitor rule, used by the website-visitor vectors: the classification of one request as the gateway records it (ua_class, bot_category from the User-Agent, outcome). The result is {visitor, bot_client} (contract/monitoring.Visitor and BotClient): visitor true when the request adds its client key to the "Besucher" estimates (MetricBucket clients unique, new and unique_day, per website and gateway-wide; getWebsiteKpis visitors; getWebsiteRealtime visitors_5m and points[].visitors; TrafficNow.clients_unique): a browser user agent (ua_class browser, bot_category likely_browser) whose request schild forwarded (outcome passed or would_block). bot_client true when the request adds its client key to the "Bot-Clients" estimate (clients.bots): every request that is not a browser request, whatever schild did with it. ua_class browser and bot_category likely_browser come together (both say: no bot, no tool, a browser user agent); none (no User-Agent) is always likely_automated. Never sent anywhere.
